lessons.title: स्थानकं कुत्र अस्ति? (sthānakaṃ kutra asti?) — asking the way
lessons.gloss: where is the station? — asking the way, and the polite -tu of the answer

segments.text: Before the new one: say "where?" and "please". (kutra, kṛpayā.) You are in a town you do not know, and you need the station.

blocks.title: You'll want to know: where, how, how far

segments.text: स्थानकं कुत्र अस्ति? sthānakaṃ kutra asti? — "Where is the station?"
कियत् दूरम् अस्ति? kiyat dūram asti? — "How far is it?"
कियत् (kiyat), "how much", with दूरम् (dūram), "far", asks the distance, and कथं गच्छामि? (kathaṃ gacchāmi?) asks "how do I get there?" The answer:
बहु दूरं न अस्ति। bahu dūraṃ na asti. — "It is not very far."

blocks.title: You'll want to know: left, right, straight on

segments.text: वामतः (vāmataḥ), "on the left", is वामः, "left", with -taḥ; दक्षिणतः (dakṣiṇataḥ), "on the right", is दक्षिणः with it. ऋजु (ṛju), "straight", is ऋजुः said as an adverb. What to do takes -तु, the polite ending of ददातु (dadātu): गच्छतु (gacchatu), "please go".
ऋजु गच्छतु। ṛju gacchatu. — "Go straight on."
ततः वामतः गच्छतु। tataḥ vāmataḥ gacchatu. — "Then turn left."
स्थानकं दक्षिणतः अस्ति। sthānakaṃ dakṣiṇataḥ asti. — "The station is on the right."
-तु speaks to भवान्, or to भवती (bhavatī), a woman:
भवती अत्र तिष्ठतु। bhavatī atra tiṣṭhatu. — "Please wait here."

segments.instruction: "Please go straight on" — kṛpayā ṛju gacchatu
segments.source: [YOU SAY: "Please go straight on" — *kṛpayā ṛju gacchatu*]

segments.prompt: Ask politely where the station is, then answer that it is on the right: go straight on, then right.
acceptedResponses: kṛpayā, sthānakaṃ kutra asti? ṛju gacchatu, tataḥ dakṣiṇataḥ gacchatu
कृपया, स्थानकं कुत्र अस्ति? ऋजु गच्छतु, ततः दक्षिणतः गच्छतु।

feedback.correct: kutra asks the place; gacchatu tells the way, politely.
feedback.incorrect: Ask with kutra; answer with ṛju, vāmataḥ or dakṣiṇataḥ and gacchatu.

segments.text: "Where is the station?" (स्थानकं कुत्र अस्ति? (sthānakaṃ kutra asti?)) "How far is it?" (कियत् दूरम् अस्ति?) "On the left"? (वामतः.) "Please go"? (गच्छतु.)

segments.text: वामतः or दक्षिणतः, for "on the right"? (दक्षिणतः.) Which ending makes a request polite? (-तु: गच्छतु, तिष्ठतु.) Now the other way round: what does कथं गच्छामि? ask? ("How do I get there?")
